summary: Sqube spin-off game. Run in the darkness with your geometry cube.
description:
Run, jump, and hide in this action packed platformer game! Can you get the high score?

Take the role of a heroic cube who funrun through difficult geometry puzzles and blockjumps. In a world of black and white geometry shapes, jump free and run towards freedom. This game is a new game and an offline game. Run with black square and play with your friends.

Difficult but rewarding gameplay!
Sqube Darkness is a platformer geometry cube game with dangerous enemies and hard obstacles. Players use their reflexes to jump and run at the correct moments to escape from the attacks of the Eyes. 
Running games are quite popular, but Sqube Darkness doesn’t follow the geometry formula used by other kinds of freeballgames. There is a vast array of unique levels and you will never get tired of run and jump action. 

Different ways to play!
Players can use swipe or on-screen button controls to run and jump. This freerun game is truly free and all cubes can feel block jumping however they like. As a game with beautiful geometry shapes and geometry dashes, you will always feel sharp! Free offline games and nice games. 

Increase your stats and skills!
Each temple running gives you stat points to develop your heroic cube character. Buy boosters and increase stats to run and jump better and faster. As a free run cube, you will always find something to improve with your geometry cube character. Play this multiplayer black cube game. Follow the geometry line.

Challenge the world!
Set a high score and compare yourself against the other players in the world. Subway surfing might be good at this game, but you can prove to be better at run and jump action. Control your geometry cube perfectly to get into the top spots!

Features:
• Flexible gameplay with two different control methods: Buttons or swipe.
• Difficult but rewarding gameplay.
• It is safe to play and can be labeled as one of the ‘gamesforkids.’
• Beautiful visuals will make you feel like a cube in a geometry world.
• Run and jump better after each playthrough by increasing your skills and buying boosters.
• Completely free game experience.
• No internet required.
• Frequent updates to add new game modes and challenges.
• Fun for all ages: Good game for family & friends’ gatherings!
• Download this funny game for free.
• Great exercise for the brain.
• Simple and highly addictive game play.
• Play without the internet.
• Play offline.

 Have fun!
